design: four independent reloads of ONE complete checkpoint per founding block. A and B are selected prospectively before history assignment by the frozen-site reader; largest(st) is never an identity. Orientation HL/LH alternates by block parity, balanced prospectively.
determinism: the model is FULLY DETERMINISTIC (Phase A audit: no random draw anywhere in the engine step). Exogenous noise is the empty set after the branch point, so branch-independence is exact by construction and R4 is discharged by a no-random-path audit rather than an artificial tape.

endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.COUPLING_OFF_ABOLITION: tau_off[b] = 0.5 * sum_k q[b,k] * (Y[b,k,OFF_SWAP] - Y[b,k,OFF_SHAM]) must be BITWISE zero, and every public field of OFF_SWAP and OFF_SHAM must be bitwise identical. tau_public_path[b] = tau_on[b] - tau_off[b].
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.DELAYED_PUBLIC_MEDIATOR_EFFECT: (mean c in the frozen halo support at t = 200)[ON_SWAP] - [ON_SHAM], oriented by q, with the first 40 steps excluded as the instantaneous constitutive transient. Same predicted sign, one-sided.
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.EARLY_PUBLIC_FLUX_EFFECT: sum over t = 1..40 of (mean c in the frozen halo support)[ON_SWAP] - [ON_SHAM], oriented by q. PREDICTED SIGN: NEGATIVE, one-sided. Derivation: kappa = 1 + g tanh(z) with g > 0, so a higher z raises the local material-bath permeability; the component is a net c SOURCE (s*rho), so raising its boundary permeability drains its own attractant halo faster and LOWERS the local c.
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.HELD_OUT_REPLICATION: the complete fixed chain repeats at the already designated held-out geometry NEAR with no change of operator, gain, reader, window, threshold, margin or analysis.
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.TWIN_PAIRED_DELAYED_RESPONSE_EFFECT: tau_on[b] = 0.5 * sum_k q[b,k] * (Y[b,k,ON_SWAP] - Y[b,k,ON_SHAM]). TWO-SIDED: the response reader is a perturbed-minus-control difference vector and no unambiguous sign is derivable from the equations before outcomes.
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.Y: the mean of the FROZEN 20-dimensional PPAI/DOMC response vector at each site, in RAW units, challenge launched at t0 + 200 (>= the frozen delay D_LATE = 120)
endpoints_frozen_before_outcomes.q: sign(zbar_k[ON_SWAP] - zbar_k[ON_SHAM]) at t0, oriented before any future execution

excluded_claims: public-state matching between historically different components
inference: the founding block is the independent unit; components and arms are paired repeated counterfactual observations. Exact paired sign-flip randomisation inference on the block-level statistic, with direct confidence intervals and every raw block value published. Deterministic identity gates use BITWISE equality, never p > 0.05. Hierarchical gatekeeping in the endpoint order above. ITT: no conditioning on delivery, lineage retention, survival or visible effect.

operator_P.algorithm: m* = min(M_A,M_B); a = m*/M_A; b = m*/M_B; z_A <- z_A + a(zbar_B - zbar_A); z_B <- z_B + b(zbar_A - zbar_B)
operator_P.applied: through a buffer, never destructively in place; identity outside A and B; touches Mf[0] only
operator_P.built_from: the PRE-INTERVENTION checkpoint only: canonical state plus prospective A/B membership from the frozen-site reader. Never a future value, a response, a branch label, a dynamic largest(st) or a held-out result.
operator_P.conserves_exactly: Sigma rho z (extensive z content), by construction
operator_P.involutive: only when M_A == M_B; otherwise DECLARED not involutive, with an exact stored inverse
operator_P.unequal_masses: the lighter component exchanges its whole mean; the heavier exchanges only the mass-matched share, so the excess material is left unchanged. The transferred fraction is fixed by the masses alone and is published.

question: Starting from one complete checkpoint, does a prespecified intervention on z change the later public flux, public mediator and delayed response of a component relative to its own exact counterfactual twin under the same exogenous future noise?

z.aliases_and_descendants: kappa(z) is recomputed inside every step from Mf and rho; there is no cache and no other derived view. Mf[1] (m2) is an independent coordinate and is never touched.
z.definition: z = m1 = Mf[0]/rho, an INTENSIVE material-carried concentration
